orders.title: Orders
orders.text: Buyers' orders by ship date: pieces by size and colour, value, and what each needs from the store.
orders.made: Order {number} made. Fill in the pieces by size and colour.
orders.dialog_text: Pick the style (its buyer comes with it). The pieces by size and colour come next, on the order.
orders.no_styles: Make a style first: an order is always for a style.
orders.empty_text: A buyer's order (PO) for a style shows here with its ship date and pieces.
orders.not_found: That order does not exist here.

steps.confirm_text: The buyer's order is firm. Pieces can still change while it is confirmed (buyers amend).
steps.start_text: From now on its pieces and price no longer change.
steps.cancel_text: The order stays on the list as cancelled, with your reason.

sheet.title: Pieces by size and colour
sheet.text_open: Type the pieces in each cell; totals add up as you type. Save when done.

needs.title: Materials needed
needs.text: From the style's bill of materials, with wastage, against what all the company's stores hold now.
needs.empty_text: Add the style's bill of materials and the pieces of the order.

styles.title: Styles and BOM
styles.text: Each buyer's styles: sizes, colours and what one piece or dozen is made of.
styles.dialog_text: The buyer comes from CRM; you can add a new one here.
styles.empty_text: Add a buyer's style with its sizes and colours, then its bill of materials.
styles.not_found: That style does not exist here.

bom.title: Bill of materials
bom.text: What it takes {per}, with wastage. A line can be for one size or colour only.
bom.empty_text: Add fabric, thread, buttons, labels, packing… each an Inventory item.

buyers.add_text: Kept in CRM as an organization tagged "buyer", with its contacts, calls and deals.
buyers.name: Buyer's name

fields_.list_hint: In order, with a comma between.

fields.title: Own fields
fields.text: Fields your factory adds to orders and styles (season, GSM, fabric composition…). Key and kind stay once made; a field is switched off, never removed.
fields.empty_order: Add what your orders need beyond the usual: season, payment terms, port…
fields.empty_style: Add what your styles need: GSM, fabric composition, wash…
fields.label: Name
fields.key_hint: Lower case letters, digits and _ (made from the English name if left empty).

conflict: Someone changed this a moment ago. It is fresh now; make your change again.
